name: Salesforce
one_liner: World's #1 AI CRM platform unifying customer data, workflows, and autonomous AI agents
notes: Per-tenant base URL required (MyDomainName.my.salesforce.com). API call limits per 24h based on edition/licenses. Chatter REST APIs have per-user/app/hour rate limits. Free Developer Edition available for self-serve testing. Partner security review required for GE/PE org REST API access.

name: HubSpot
one_liner: Build demand, win deals, and delight customers — all on one platform
notes: Base URL is api.hubapi.com. Rate limits vary by plan tier; 429s returned on excess. Some features (webhooks, enterprise APIs) require paid/Enterprise plans. MCP server available for CRM read/write. Service Keys act as scoped bearer tokens for integrations.

name: Pipedrive
one_liner: CRM for closing deals: track sales pipeline, manage deals with AI, automate sales processes
notes: Token-based rate limits introduced Dec 2024 (S8). API v1 and v2 available; v2 has lower token cost. MCP connector live in Claude and ChatGPT marketplaces. Sandbox account available free for development.

name: Attio
one_liner: CRM for modern go-to-market teams with flexible data model
notes: Free plan: up to 3 users, 50k records. MCP server at mcp.attio.com (OAuth). Rate limiting documented. App review only required for publishing to public app store; API keys are self-serve. Webhooks supported.

name: Twenty
one_liner: Open-source CRM for teams that track relationships, manage pipelines, and take action quickly
notes: Schema-per-tenant: no static API ref; endpoints generated per workspace. Rate limits: 50 req/min (Pro), 100 req/min (Org). Self-hostable OSS at your own domain. MCP server included on all paid plans. 30-day free trial, no credit card.

name: Podio
one_liner: Unify and automate work with no-code tools, flexible workflows and customizable business solutions.
notes: Two rate limits apply (Limit A for resource-intensive ops, Limit B for all others); paid accounts can purchase API Add-on for higher limits. Official MCP server at https://mcp.podio.com is currently in beta.

name: Zoho CRM
one_liner: AI-powered CRM platform that supercharges sales with intelligent automation and intuitive design
notes: Per-tenant OAuth2 setup required with datacenter-specific base URLs (US, EU, AU, IN, etc.). Free plan limited to 3 users. Developer Edition and sandbox available for testing. API rate limits not detailed in sources.

name: Close
one_liner: Sales CRM built for teams that sell with calling, email, SMS, pipeline management, and AI built in
notes: API keys use HTTP Basic auth (key as username, blank password). OAuth 2.0 required for multi-tenant/public integrations. MCP server at https://mcp.close.com/mcp. Dev org available free for integration partners via email request.

name: Copper
one_liner: CRM software for relationship-focused service businesses built to work inside Google Workspace
notes: Rate limit: 180 requests/minute (rolling window); bulk APIs limited to 3 req/sec. API key requires user email in every request header. OAuth2.0 scope currently only supports developer/v1/all (full read/write). Official MCP server in beta (November 2026), read-only initially.

name: DealCloud
one_liner: AI-powered deal and relationship intelligence platform for professional firms
notes: Per-tenant base URL required (e.g. example.dealcloud.com). MCP server needs 'DealCloud with Celeste' license. API capability must be enabled per user in Admin. Publications API requires site configuration.

name: Zendesk
one_liner: AI-powered customer service platform for better customer and employee experiences
notes: Per-tenant subdomain base URL: {subdomain}.zendesk.com. Rate limits vary by plan and endpoint; High Volume API Add-On available. API tokens being deprecated—migrate custom actions to OAuth. 14-day free trial self-serve.

name: Intercom
one_liner: AI-powered helpdesk with omnichannel inbox, ticketing, and AI agent
notes: Private apps: 10,000 API calls/minute per workspace. MCP server available for US and EU regions only; AU not yet supported. After 14-day trial, paid subscription required (from $29/seat/month).

name: Freshdesk
one_liner: AI-powered customer support platform uniting tickets, agents, and workflows
notes: API unavailable on free plan; requires Blossom+ (paid). Rate limits 3000-5000 req/hr by plan; additional calls purchasable. Per-tenant base URL: domain.freshdesk.com. Official MCP server GA Sept 2026 with annual action allowances per plan.

name: Front
one_liner: All-in-one customer support platform bringing teams and AI agents together to resolve requests
notes: Rate limits: Starter 50 req/min, Professional 100, Enterprise 200. OAuth partner integrations get separate 120 req/min per company. MCP server is in beta, requires form sign-up. Base URL: api2.frontapp.com.

name: Pylon
one_liner: Agentic support platform where humans and AI agents collaborate on B2B customer work
notes: Regional MCP URLs: mcp.usepylon.com (US) and mcp.eu.usepylon.com (EU). Rate limits return 429 with Retry-After header. Paid plans from $89/seat/month; trial requires sales rep setup. MCP Access permission required for MCP use.

name: LiveAgent
one_liner: Cloud help desk for email, live chat, phone and social media in one shared inbox with AI agents
notes: API rate limit: 180 requests/minute per API key on cloud accounts. MCP server URL is per-tenant: https://<tenant>/api/mcp. MCP supports OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) and bearer tokens. Up to 10 active MCP tokens per account.

name: Plain
one_liner: Agentic platform to orchestrate customer support work for teams and AI agents
notes: GraphQL API only (no REST). No rate limits stated. API hosted in UK region (core-api.uk.plain.com). Native MCP server available. TypeScript GraphQL SDK provided. 7-day self-serve trial; paid plan needed beyond that.

name: Help Scout
one_liner: AI-powered shared inbox and helpdesk unifying email, SMS, chat, social, and voice for support teams
notes: API blocked on free plan; requires Standard ($25/u/mo+). Rate limits: 200/400/800 calls/min by plan tier. Mailbox API uses OAuth2 bearer tokens; Docs API uses API key via Basic Auth. Official MCP server at https://mcp.helpscout.net/mcp (read-only).

name: Gorgias
one_liner: Conversational Commerce platform for Shopify brands unifying AI, inbox, and customer data
notes: Per-tenant subdomain base URL (your-account.gorgias.com). API key via Basic auth and OAuth2 both supported. 7-day free trial then paid plan required. MCP server at https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp included on all Helpdesk plans.

name: Gladly
one_liner: AI commerce platform to sell, serve, and support customers from one chat
notes: Rate limit: 10 req/sec for all standard methods; Reports API: 10 req/min + 2 concurrent requests. Sandbox at {org}.gladly.qa; production base URL is per-tenant: {organization}.gladly.com. API tokens tied to individual user accounts.

name: Slack
one_liner: Team messaging platform connecting people and AI agents to collaborate and automate work
notes: Free Developer Program gives sandbox access. App must be registered at api.slack.com/apps to get Client ID/Secret. Sandbox active for 6 months, up to 2 active at a time. MCP server officially supported.

name: Twilio
one_liner: Customer engagement platform for SMS, voice, email, and AI-powered conversations
notes: Base URL: https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01. Preferred auth is API key (SID as username, secret as password) over Basic. Regional infrastructure available for data residency. MCP server at mcp.twilio.com/docs. Pay-as-you-go after free trial.

name: Zoho Cliq
one_liner: Team communication and collaboration platform powering productivity for all kinds of teams and businesses
notes: OAuth2 access tokens expire after 1 hour; refresh token flow required. Base URL is data-center-specific: accounts.zoho.{dc}. MCP server available with rate limiting and OAuth auth. Free plan exists enabling self-serve access.

name: Lark (Larksuite)
one_liner: Collaboration platform integrating messaging, calendar, docs, email, video conferencing, and automation
notes: Custom apps are self-serve; Store apps may require review. Supports tenant_access_token and user_access_token. OAuth endpoint rate limit: 1000/min, 50/sec. Official MCP server via lark-mcp CLI. SDKs for Go, Python, Java, Node available.

name: Pumble
one_liner: Secure, flexible, and easy to use team communication and collaboration app
notes: Rate limit 1000 requests/minute per user. MCP server at mcp.pumble.com requires App key + User/Bot token. API addon must be installed per workspace. Swagger docs available after API key auth.

name: Discord
one_liner: Group chat platform for gaming, communities, voice, video, and text communication
notes: Base URL: https://discord.com/api. Rate limits documented at /developers/topics/rate-limits. App Review required for scaling or sensitive scopes. Bot token and OAuth2 bearer both supported. Gateway (WebSocket) for real-time events.

name: Telegram
one_liner: Messaging platform offering APIs for bots, custom clients, and verification code delivery
notes: Bot API uses bot tokens (api_key); Telegram API uses api_id/api_hash via MTProto; Gateway API charges per delivered verification message; each phone number limited to one api_id; client libraries strictly monitored for abuse.

name: WhatsApp Business
one_liner: Enterprise-grade APIs for messaging and calling on WhatsApp at scale
notes: 1,000 free conversations/month then per-conversation fees. App Review required for public production apps. Official MCP server at mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools is in beta. Per-tenant phone number IDs used as path params.

name: Aircall
one_liner: AI-powered platform for customer communications combining voice agents, workflows, and coaching
notes: Full API access is a Professional-tier feature ($50/user/month, min 3 users). Rate limiting applies — check docs before building. OAuth access_token is non-expiring Bearer token. MCP integration is coming soon, not yet available.

name: Vonage
one_liner: Communications platform combining APIs, unified communications, and contact center software for businesses
notes: Free credits on signup, no credit card needed. Auth varies by API: Basic (key/secret), JWT, or OAuth2. Official MCP servers available. Startup program offers up to $75k in API credits. Postman workspace published.

name: Google Ads
one_liner: Programmatic interface for managing Google Ads accounts and campaigns at scale
notes: Developer token required; Explorer Access (immediate, 2880 ops/day) now available; Basic/Standard Access require approval for higher limits. OAuth2 mandatory. Per-manager-account developer token setup needed. Official MCP server available.

name: Meta Ads
one_liner: API to create and manage ad campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and WhatsApp
notes: Development access granted by default but is limited; standard/advanced access requires app review and Business Verification. Rate limits apply per ad account (error 80004/613). Official MCP server in open beta requires no coding.

name: LinkedIn Ads
one_liner: Helps businesses reach, engage, and convert professional audiences via marketing campaign APIs
notes: Development tier is self-serve; production/full access requires vetting and approval. Data limit: 45M metric values per 5-min interval. API is versioned; v202601 sunsets Jan 15 2027. Base URL: api.linkedin.com/rest/.

name: GoHighLevel
one_liner: AI-powered business operating system to capture, nurture, and close leads into customers
notes: API access requires at least the Unlimited plan ($297/mo). V1 APIs end-of-support Dec 2025; use V2. Standard rate limits apply. Per-sub-account OAuth scopes; MCP server exposes 600+ operations across 38 domains.

name: Mailchimp
one_liner: Integrate data with intelligent marketing tools and event-driven transactional email and SMS
notes: OpenAPI spec publicly available at api.mailchimp.com/schema/openapi/OpenAPI.json. Official MCP servers for both Marketing (S8) and Transactional APIs (S9 at mandrillapp.com/mcp). Integration Partner Program requires 25+ active users and OAuth2 support.

name: Klaviyo
one_liner: B2C CRM platform unifying marketing, analytics, and service into always-on growth engines
notes: Rate limits are per-account with burst and steady fixed-window algorithms; HTTP 429 on breach. API versioning via 'revision' header required. Base URL: a.klaviyo.com. Conversations API requires separate per-account enablement. MCP server at mcp.klaviyo.com/mcp.

name: systeme.io
one_liner: All-in-one platform for email marketing, sales funnels, courses, and business automation
notes: API key passed via X-API-Key header. Rate limit enforced with 429 + Retry-After header; quota shared across all API keys. Free plan includes full API access. Cursor-based pagination via startingAfter parameter.

name: Pinterest
one_liner: One API to seamlessly integrate with Pinterest for content, ads, and analytics
notes: MCP server not yet launched (sign-up for updates). Sandbox support available. Rate limits use categories (e.g., org_write). OAuth2 Client Credentials flow available for developer-own-account automation.

name: Threads (Meta)
one_liner: Create and publish posts, retrieve media and profiles, moderate replies, and access insights
notes: Base URL: graph.threads.com. Rate limits: 250 posts per 24 hours, 1000 replies per 24 hours. App Review required for production/public-facing apps accessing user data beyond developer's own account.

name: SendGrid
one_liner: Trusted email API and marketing campaigns platform for delivery at scale
notes: 60-day free trial; after trial, paid plan required or email sending is blocked. API keys passed as Bearer tokens. SMTP relay also supported. Marketing Campaigns endpoints require paid Marketing plan.

name: Shopify
one_liner: Build apps and storefronts that extend Shopify's core ecommerce functionality
notes: Per-tenant OAuth token exchange required for Admin API; REST API deprecated in favor of GraphQL. API versioned quarterly (1-year support). Partner API rate-limited to 4 req/s. MCP server available via npx @shopify/dev-mcp.

name: WooCommerce
one_liner: Free, open-source ecommerce platform for WordPress to build custom online stores
notes: Per-tenant base URL required (each merchant's own WordPress/WooCommerce install). Store API is unauthenticated for public cart/checkout. GraphQL is experimental. WooCommerce's native MCP endpoint removed in v11.3.

name: BigCommerce
one_liner: Build, customize, and scale ecommerce storefronts, apps, and integrations on BigCommerce.
notes: Trial sandbox is free but time-limited; production requires paid plan. Rate limits are plan-based (e.g., Core: 150 req/30s window). Per-store base URL includes store hash. B2B API uses separate base URL api-b2b.bigcommerce.com. MCP server available for docs and storefront.

name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
one_liner: Develop personalized ecommerce experiences with fast, flexible B2B/D2C and B2C solutions.
notes: Rate limits use 5s or 60s tiers per API family. MCP server (B2C DX) is developer preview only, not GA. Per-tenant sandbox required. All pricing requires contacting Salesforce sales.

name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
one_liner: Customize and extend Adobe Commerce for multichannel, global B2B and B2C commerce
notes: Per-tenant base URLs; each store instance has its own domain. Open Source is free/self-hosted; Adobe Commerce Cloud requires paid plan. OAuth 1.0a for third-party apps; IMS bearer tokens for Cloud Service SaaS.

name: Squarespace
one_liner: Website and ecommerce platform with APIs for commerce, domains, apps, and reselling
notes: Reseller API and some tools are invite-only. Each API key/OAuth token is scoped to a single website (per-tenant). Paid Squarespace plan required (Core tier minimum) to generate API keys. MCP server requires no install.

name: Ecwid
one_liner: E-commerce platform to create an online store and sell anywhere online or in person
notes: Rate limit: 600 requests/minute per token; exceeding returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After header. No test mode; use a separate store for dev. Free paid-plan upgrade available via email for developers. Per-tenant store IDs required in all requests.

name: Gumroad
one_liner: Gumroad is a powerful, but simple, e-commerce platform for selling digital products
notes: Rate limits per token: 30 PUTs/min, 60 previews/min. Manual access tokens for single-account use; full OAuth2 flow for multi-account apps. Resources include Products, Sales, Subscribers, License Keys.

name: Amazon Selling Partner
one_liner: REST-based API for Amazon Selling Partners to access orders, shipments, payments, and more programmatically
notes: Uses Login with Amazon (LWA) OAuth2. Private seller apps self-serve; public/third-party apps require developer registration and app review. Each selling partner must individually authorize your app. Regional sandbox endpoints available for testing.

name: fanbasis
one_liner: One place to create, sell, and get paid, with payments built in
notes: API access grouped under 'Enterprise & APIs' heading — likely requires sales contact. Official MCP server exists but is in beta. No public developer docs URL found in any source. Platform also branded as 'Commas'.

name: DataForSEO
one_liner: Provides comprehensive SEO and digital marketing data solutions via API
notes: Rate limits per endpoint via X-RateLimit-Limit/X-RateLimit-Remaining headers (per minute). $1 trial credit on signup; real use requires minimum $50 top-up (pay-as-you-go, no expiry). Sandbox available for free integration testing.

name: SE Ranking
one_liner: SEO platform for agencies and in-house marketing teams with keyword research, rank tracking, audits, and more
notes: Default rate limit is 5 req/sec (configurable via support). Credits-based billing; 14-day trial includes 100K credits. MCP server hosted at https://api.seranking.com/mcp. No first-party SDKs; Postman collection available.

name: Ahrefs
one_liner: SEO and marketing platform to research keywords, analyze backlinks, track rankings, and monitor brand visibility
notes: API v3; Lite plan minimum for MCP/API; Enterprise for uncapped access (requires sales). OAuth2 keys default to 200k API units/month. Minimum 50 units per request. Rank Tracker and management endpoints consume no units.

name: MrScraper
one_liner: MrScraper turns websites into clean, structured data with AI-powered scraping, APIs, proxies, and automation
notes: Free tier: 1,000 tokens/month, no credit card. Paid from $99/month. API auth via x-api-token header; OAuth 2.1 on hosted MCP at mcp.mrscraper.com/mcp. Extra usage billed at $1/1,000 tokens.

name: Apify
one_liner: Cloud platform for web scraping, data extraction, and automation via serverless Actors
notes: Global rate limit 250,000 req/min; per-resource default 60 req/sec. API token found at console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Official clients for JS, Python, Go, PHP, Java, .NET, Rust. Full OpenAPI spec publicly downloadable.

name: Firecrawl
one_liner: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter
notes: Keyless (no-auth) access available for /v2/scrape, /v2/search, /v2/parse with limits. Official MCP server at mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp. OpenAPI spec at api-reference/v2-openapi.json. Per-plan rate limits apply; free tier has concurrency limits.

name: Bright Data
one_liner: Discover, access, extract, and interact with any public website at petabyte-scale.
notes: Free tier: 5,000 credits/month, no credit card, 1,000 req/min rate limit (removed after adding funds). MCP server at mcp.brightdata.com supports API key (query param) or OAuth 2.1. Proxy native access uses username/password. Agent self-registration protocol available.

name: Sherlock
one_liner: Hunt down social media accounts by username across 400+ social networks
notes: No hosted API; runs locally via CLI, pipx, or Docker. A self-hosted REST API (Django REST Framework) exists at github.com/sherlock-project/api but must be run locally on port 8000. No rate-limit or auth documentation found.

name: Waterfall.io
one_liner: B2B data API for go-to-market workflows aggregating 30+ data vendors
notes: Default rate limit 50 req/60s per sub-key. Many endpoints are async (return job_id, fetch result later). Usage-based prepaid pricing; minimums/commitments set at contract. Access requires team approval, typically replied to within hours.

name: Clay
one_liner: Infrastructure to get any data, run agentic workflows, and launch GTM plays
notes: API key passed in `clay-api-key` header. Search result limits scale with plan; 30-day rolling windows (Enterprise: custom). HTTP 402 returned on limit breach. CLI also available for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor).

name: GitHub
one_liner: Platform supporting the entire software development process, from planning to deploying and operating software.
notes: Base URL is api.github.com. Rate limits differ for authenticated vs unauthenticated requests. API versioning via X-GitHub-Api-Version header. Supports webhooks and GitHub Apps for event-driven integrations.

name: Vercel
one_liner: Deploy and scale frontends with CI/CD, functions, analytics, and storage
notes: Free Hobby plan allows API access. Tokens sent as Bearer. Rate limits return 429. Add teamId/slug param for team-scoped requests. OpenAPI spec at vercel.com/openapi.json. Official MCP server documented at /docs/mcp.

name: Netlify
one_liner: Netlify is a hosting service for the programmable web
notes: Rate limiting exists but details truncated in sources. OpenAPI spec at open-api.netlify.com (v2.63.1). Official MCP server installable via `npx @netlify/mcp`. PAT tokens have configurable expiration.

name: Cloudflare
one_liner: Platform providing networking, security, and developer infrastructure via broad REST API
notes: Base URL: api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/; account_id required in most paths. Free plan restricts some features (API Shield, Cloudforce One). OpenAPI spec publicly available. OAuth2 supported for third-party app integrations.

name: Supabase
one_liner: Open-source backend platform with Postgres database, auth, storage, edge functions, and realtime
notes: Per-project REST base URL uses project ref. Management API rate limits apply; analytics/domain endpoints have stricter limits. OpenAPI spec at api.supabase.com/api/v1-json. OAuth2 integration available for building Supabase OAuth apps.

name: Neo4j
one_liner: Graph database platform for storing and querying connected data at scale
notes: REST API deprecated; current paths are HTTP API and Bolt via official drivers. Free AuraDB tier available indefinitely with node/relationship limits. Official MCP server documented at neo4j.com/docs/mcp. Bearer tokens expire in 15-60 minutes.

name: Snowflake
one_liner: Fully managed, enterprise-ready platform for data and AI innovation
notes: Per-tenant base URL pattern: myorganization-myaccount.snowflakecomputing.com. 30-day trial with $400 credits; paid plan required after. REST APIs still expanding, not full SQL parity. Supports key-pair JWT, OAuth, and PAT auth.

name: MongoDB Atlas
one_liner: Manage all components in MongoDB Atlas programmatically via REST API
notes: Rate limit: per-project per-minute; HTTP 429 on exceed (S10). OAuth2 tokens valid 1 hour, non-refreshable. Base URL: cloud.mongodb.com; GovCloud: cloudgov.mongodb.com. Official MCP server GA as of Aug 2026.

name: Datadog
one_liner: Observability platform supporting every phase of software development on any stack
notes: Multiple regional base URLs: US1, US3, US5, EU, AP1, AP2, UK1, US1-FED, US2-FED. Official MCP server at mcp.datadoghq.com. OAuth2 also supported for marketplace/partner integrations. Some preview MCP toolsets require CSM contact or sign-up.

name: Sentry
one_liner: Sentry helps developers find and fix what's broken
notes: API is v0 but public endpoints are stable. Region-specific domains available (e.g. us.sentry.io) for lower latency. Free developer plan is 1-user only. Per-tenant org slug required in URL paths. MCP server at mcp.sentry.dev supports OAuth.

name: Notion
one_liner: AI workspace where teams and agents collaborate, capturing knowledge and pushing projects forward
notes: PAT creation restricted by default on Business/Enterprise plans (workspace owner must enable). OAuth2 required for multi-tenant/public integrations. Official remote MCP server available. Pagination defaults to 10 items per call.

name: Airtable
one_liner: Platform to run business processes and build flexible apps on shared data
notes: Standard REST API + Webhooks are self-serve (free plan) using Personal Access Tokens or OAuth2. API keys deprecated Feb 2024. Enterprise API (admin/GDPR endpoints) requires Enterprise plan. Official MCP server available for Claude, ChatGPT, and CLI.

name: Linear
one_liner: The product development system for teams and agents
notes: Free plan includes API and webhook access. GraphQL API supports introspection. TypeScript SDK available. Official MCP server at mcp.linear.app with OAuth 2.1 and API key auth. Rate limits exist but specific values not documented in sources.

name: Jira
one_liner: Project management tool that helps any team plan, track, and deliver work
notes: Per-tenant base URL uses cloud ID. REST API v3 for Cloud. MCP server available at mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2. Scoped OAuth2 tokens recommended; classic API tokens also work with Basic auth.

name: Asana
one_liner: Work management platform to integrate tools, automate actions, and customize workflows
notes: Public OpenAPI spec on GitHub. MCP server at mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp uses OAuth2 bearer tokens; access tokens expire after 1 hour. Developer sandbox available for testing outside production data.

name: Monday.com
one_liner: AI work platform that helps teams plan, execute, and deliver work in one connected place
notes: Hosted MCP at mcp.monday.com/mcp; MCP tool calls count toward daily GraphQL API call limit. Free developer sandbox includes Pro/Enterprise features. OpenAPI index at developer.monday.com/apps/llms.txt.

name: ClickUp
one_liner: Everything you need to stay organized and get work done.
notes: MCP available on all plans; MCP rate limit 300 req/24h per AI assistant on paid plans; MCP shares budget with public API. Personal tokens never expire. API v2 base: api.clickup.com/api/v2.

name: Coda
one_liner: Collaborative all-in-one platform that blends the best of docs, spreadsheets, and applications
notes: Rate limits: 100 req/6s reads, 10 req/6s writes, 5 req/10s doc-content writes, 4 req/6s listing docs. Official MCP server available. API now branded Superhuman Docs API. No official client libraries except Google Apps Script; Swagger Generator supported.

name: Smartsheet
one_liner: A work management platform that connects teams, workflows, and AI in one place
notes: API requires Business, Enterprise, or AWM paid plan. Smartsheet Gov and Regions Europe use separate tokens. OAuth2 and API key (bearer) both supported. Official MCP server live with 30+ tools. SDKs for JS, Python, Java, C#.

name: Harvest
one_liner: Harvest helps professional teams track time, bill clients, optimize team time, and measure performance with confidence.
notes: Rate limit: 100 req/15s general, 100 req/15min for Reports API; HTTP 429 on exceed with Retry-After header. Every request requires Harvest-Account-Id header. Official MCP at https://api.harvestapp.com/mcp.

name: Stripe
one_liner: Financial infrastructure to grow your revenue
notes: Free sandbox available; sandbox API key determines live vs test mode. Official MCP server at mcp.stripe.com (public preview); full-secret-key auth for MCP deprecated December 2026—migrate to OAuth or agent API keys.

name: Plaid
one_liner: Connects financial accounts to apps and services securely via API
notes: Trial free but capped at 10 Production Items; Growth/Custom plans need sales contact. EU/UK users only get Custom plans. Some products (Transfer, Signal, Layer) require Custom plan. client_id+secret sent via headers or request body.

name: Binance
one_liner: Crypto exchange for spot, margin, futures trading, market data, and wallet management
notes: REQUEST_WEIGHT limit 6000/min; RAW_REQUESTS 300000/5min; CONNECTIONS 300/5min. OAuth login is partner-only. Developer integrations need business verification and app review. OAuth/MCP products gated; Spot API key access is self-serve for personal use.

name: Paygent Connect
one_liner: Payment gateway for processing credit and debit card transactions from terminal to card issuer
notes: Direct Connect requires joining program via NMI account manager or sales request. Sandbox at guide.nmi.com. MCP server at https://docs.nmi.com/mcp (no auth needed). OAuth2 also supported per S5.

name: iPayX
one_liner: Neutral FX verification layer that audits foreign-exchange transactions and reveals invisible spreads
notes: The /developers and /docs/api pages return only marketing content with no actual API documentation, authentication details, endpoints, or pricing. Contact info@ipayx.ai for access details.

name: QuickBooks
one_liner: Cloud-based accounting software connecting finances, workflows, and business tools in one platform
notes: OAuth2 only; refresh tokens expire every 100 days requiring re-auth flow. REST + GraphQL both supported. High-volume CorePlus API calls require paid App Partner Program tier (Silver/Gold/Platinum). Per-company base URLs in use.

name: Xero
one_liner: Cloud accounting platform for small businesses with a full developer API
notes: OAuth 2.0 only; access tokens expire in 30 min. Rate limits: 60 calls/min, 1000/day (Starter), 5000/day higher tiers, 5 concurrent calls. Per-tenant xero-tenant-id header required for multi-org. Official MCP server and OpenAPI spec (GitHub) available. App Store listing requires certification (10 customers).

name: Brex
one_liner: Unified spend platform with corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel, and bill pay
notes: Rate limiting is in place per S4. OAuth access tokens expire in 3600s; refresh tokens expire every 90 days. MCP server at https://api.brex.com/mcp. APIs are staged: Alpha, Beta, GA. OpenAPI specs auto-generated from code.

name: Ramp
one_liner: Financial operations platform helping companies manage cards, expenses, bill pay, and accounting
notes: OpenAPI spec at /openapi/developer-api.json. Admin access required to create dev app credentials. For own-account use it's self-serve; partner/public integrations require applying to partner program. Official MCP server at github.com/ramp-public/ramp-mcp.

name: PitchBook
one_liner: The all-in-one private capital market solution
notes: API requires standalone contract via Direct Data team — no self-serve signup. Base URL: api.pitchbook.com. MCP Premium Connector exists for existing licensed clients (seat-based/unlimited/trial/enterprise partner). Lumonic (PitchBook subsidiary) also has a separate MCP server for portfolio monitoring.

name: NotebookLM
one_liner: AI tool for generating insights and summaries from documents
notes: v1alpha API under discoveryengine.googleapis.com; requires Gemini Notebook Enterprise license; supports US multi-regional endpoints; per-project regional base URL (ENDPOINT_LOCATION-discoveryengine.googleapis.com).

name: Otter AI
one_liner: AI notetaker and conversational intelligence platform that records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings
notes: API is Enterprise-only; requires account manager to enable. Rate limit: 10 req/sec (429 on exceed). Max 2 API keys per user. MCP server available at https://mcp.otter.ai/mcp using OAuth. Webhooks supported for event-driven integrations.

name: Fathom
one_liner: AI meeting assistant with transcripts, summaries, and action items for every call
notes: Rate limit is 60 API calls/minute per user across all API keys; no higher limits offered. API keys are user-scoped, not org-wide. MCP server available at api.fathom.ai/mcp. Webhooks use POST endpoints.

name: Consensus
one_liner: AI-powered academic search engine to find, understand, and synthesize scientific research
notes: Free plan: 30 API calls/month, page 0 only (pagination beyond page 0 requires paid). Rate limit: 1 req/sec (429 with retry-after). API and MCP calls share one monthly pool. Extra usage $0.05/call.

name: Reducto
one_liner: Agentic document platform that turns documents into structured, citation-ready data for AI teams
notes: EU and AU regional endpoints available. Deployment options: SaaS, hybrid VPC, full VPC, or air-gapped on-premises. SOC 2 Type II & HIPAA. Zero data retention policy available. OpenAPI spec at /api-reference/openapi.json.

name: Devin
one_liner: Autonomous AI software engineer that writes, runs, and tests code for engineering teams
notes: v2 analytics API rate-limited to 10 requests/hour per team (S6). OpenAPI spec file v2-openapi.yaml available. Full REST API appears enterprise-tier; free plan exists for product use but API access is enterprise-focused.

name: higgsfield
one_liner: AI-native creative suite for video production, character consistency, and ad creation
notes: Async request lifecycle; poll or use HMAC-signed webhooks. New accounts start at 2 concurrent requests, up to 40 self-serve; higher via sales. Outputs retained ≥7 days. Funds expire 1 year after top-up.

name: Mermaid CLI
one_liner: CLI tool that converts Mermaid diagram definitions to SVG, PNG, or PDF files
notes: Local CLI tool only; no hosted API or auth required. Requires Node.js and uses Puppeteer/Chromium internally. Docker image available. Third-party MCP wrappers exist but no official MCP server.

name: YouTube Transcript
one_liner: Get transcripts, search videos, browse channels, and extract playlists via REST API or YouTube MCP at scale
notes: 100 free credits, no card required. Paid plans: $5/month (200 RPM) or $54/year (300 RPM) for 1,000 credits/month. Credits pause if subscription lapses. MCP server at https://transcriptapi.com/mcp. Failed requests (4xx/5xx/429) cost 0 credits.

name: Grain
one_liner: AI notetaker that records video calls and delivers meeting data to AI tools
notes: Free plan limits meetings to 45 minutes each with 30-day history. API requires Public-Api-Version header. Rate limits documented at developers.grain.com/rate-limits. Official MCP server connects Claude.ai directly to meeting data.
